Step 1: Start date 1462-01-27.  
Step 2: 18 weeks = 18 × 7 = 126 days. Add 2 more days → total 128 days.  
Step 3: 1462 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4). Jan 27 + 4 days → Jan 31 (4 days used).  
Remaining: 128 − 4 = 124 days.  
Feb has 28 days → 124 − 28 = 96 days left after Feb.  
Mar has 31 → 96 − 31 = 65.  
Apr has 30 → 65 − 30 = 35.  
May has 31 → 35 − 31 = 4 days left.  
June 1 + 4 days = June 5.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1462-06-05
